html.title: Why can a Git merge bring back a reverted change?
为什么 Git 合并会带回已撤销的修改？
Why can a Git merge bring back a reverted change?
为什么 Git 合并会带回已撤销的修改？

changedLines: The two current values are unchanged from the first case, but the base already contains on. Now ours carries the only net change. The symmetric selection keeps off; returning the change is not inevitable.

Neither side equals the base. Incompatible edits to the same region may conflict and need a decision. Different edits do not always conflict, and a clean text merge does not prove program correctness.
